entries.entry_name: Storm Safe Zone — Lightning Storm Atronach
entries.mitigation: Call the lit pad immediately and move as a group. Do not finish a rotation in the storm; stay in the safe zone until the channel ends.
Return to center after Storm and block or shield through the expanding shockwave and follow-up ground AOEs.
Main tank keeps the boss turned away; block as needed while healers cover the five-hit splash sequence.
Off-tank grabs the Chain Spinner and Nullifier pair and stacks them on the boss for cleave.
Stay spread, assign clone coverage, and kill as many of the three clones as possible before the explosion. Fewer surviving clones means less incoming damage.
Keep taunt stable so repeated bolts stay on the tank rather than deleting a DD.
Maintain deliberate spacing so Chain Lightning cannot ramp through adjacent players while still preserving the group formation behind the boss.
Tank controls the axes away from the group through the main phase; expect them to disappear when execute begins.
Hard Mode: block the meteor impact to avoid the stun.
Hard Mode: kill Storm Atronachs quickly, especially once low health triggers continuous lightning pressure.
